lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu3S2N adopts the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166) with a unit cell containing 27 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in a trigonal bipyramidal environment with five geometric neighbors (3 N, 2 S), and N centers in octahedral coordination by six Cu atoms, while S centers are three-coordinate with Cu. Validated polyhedral contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Cu trigonal bipyramids, and corner-sharing between N octahedra.
